title: Bol Radha Bol
desc: While Kishen enjoys village life and romance with Radha, a sinister doppelganger plots. Upon returning home, he'll discover his identity and life stolen by this malevolent impostor.

title: Rudrangi
desc: Bheem Rao Deshmukh, a tyrant who oppresses his people, is drawn to a beautiful woman named Rudrangi and desires physical contact with her. In order to satisfy his obsession, he terrorises her village.

title: Pardesi
desc: An innocent villager is wrongly sentenced to death for a murder he didn't commit, but a twist of fate and a meeting with his lookalike lead to an unexpected chain of events.

title: Naag Bhoomi
desc: A dangerous criminal who traffics women terrorises a village community that ceremoniously worships a serpentine deity. Soon, an archaeologist gets caught up in the ensuing chaos.

title: Zakhmi Sipahi
desc: Shakti is an honest police officer out to avenge the death of his father. He faces many trials and tribulations in his journey towards fulfilling this task.
